sources.title: What is the startup and stop latency of a runsc container on a ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: Start the container using runsc run (full lifecycle: create → start → run → delete). Record the total container execution time (from the start of runsc run to the return of the command) and the Elapsed time reported by the Python script. Each time a loop is successfully completed, increment the count by one and return the time data.
